preconditions.description: The input is a list of strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(w, str) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Every element in the input list is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.isalpha() for c in w) for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word contains only alphabetic characters (uppercase or lowercase).

postconditions.description: The output is a list with the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) for count in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == sum(1 for idx, char in enumerate(words[i], start=1) if (ord(char.lower()) - ord('a') + 1) == idx) for i in range(len(words)))
postconditions.description: For each word, the corresponding output integer equals the count of letters whose 1-based position in the word matches their 1-based position in the alphabet (case-insensitive).
